description: CAD drawings converted from the DWG originals (knowledge/source/Desenhos Tecnicos) with LibreDWG; PNG renders, DXF conversions and extracted text. PDF drawings are documents in the catalogue (kind = drawing) and are served through get_page_image.

drawings.title: PTV WJ3020 cutting table - general arrangement (front, side, top and isometric views)
drawings.notes: AutoCAD 2007, 22 495 polylines, no text. Shows the gantry on the catcher tank with bellows-covered X rails and the Z column.

drawings.title: Water jet table in the workshop - front and top view with layers 'Estrutura Ferro', 'MAQUINAS', 'DIVISORIA', 'TELHA', 'LOI'
drawings.notes: AutoCAD 2010, Portuguese layer names (AMC workshop layout). Top view shows the catcher tank slats and the cutting head position.

drawings.title: Cabeca de corte - cutting head assembly, side and front views with the height-sensor arm bracket
drawings.notes: AutoCAD 2007, layers Acrilico/Aluminio/Ferro/Inox (AMC drawing). Shows the air actuator, ON/OFF valve, nozzle body / mixing tube, the abrasive inlet and the sensor arm with the plate PTV-012-V-3723.

drawings.title: Raminko vyskoveho senzoru - height sensor arm, PTV-012-V-3723 (19.02.2008, J. Hnatek / Ing. J. Kunert)
drawings.notes: Aluminium plate EN AW-5083, 25 mm thick, 105 x 100 blank, 0.11 kg; dimensions 96 x 101 mm overall, 40 degree arm, dia 32 +0.1 bore (detail A 2:1), M6 thread, 2 x dia 5.5 holes 16 mm apart, tolerance ISO 2768-mK.

drawings.title: Bellows X - waterproof bellows for the X axis, A. Moreira Cadete title block 23/01/2019
drawings.notes: Section 280 x 270 mm, lamella 35 mm, 5 mm internal lamella, extended length X = 3300 mm; without end frames, with plastic reinforcing lamellas. Same geometry as PTV-012-V-3762 (Lmax 6700 / Lmin 600).
